name: main
notes: game state machine on DS:0086 (1 title, 2 protection check, 4 menus, 5 race legs, 3/6 results)

name: config_load
notes: reads TD3.CFG (3 u16: video, audio -> DS:0096, midi flag -> DS:0098); if missing asks on the text screen and optionally writes it (wb+)

name: top_score_enter
notes: name entry, inserts DS:09DA score, DS:0AFE car and name into the top-7 table, then hi_write

name: top_scores_screen
notes: TOPSCOR*.LZ; prints DS:1FDE name block and the 7 scores DS:1FC2 with car names

name: snd_init
notes: once: sfx_init, music_init with DS:0096, DS:0096 = C5E3, timer_install; DS:009C = 1

name: music_for_state
notes: (arg): plays the music of main state DS:0086 (THEME / menu buffer / scene A-C by arg)

name: music_play_theme
notes: stop, load THEME.MUS into DS:E7F0, play

name: copy_protection_check
notes: returns 0 = passed; check patched out with NOPs in this copy, dead code follows (01f4:1ed7-01f4:262a)

name: playdisk_write
notes: verifies the disk (2812) then writes PLAYDISK.DAT (179 bytes: DS:0A78, 09E0, 0A34, 0AFE, 0B06, 09C2)

name: playdisk_verify
notes: loops until PLAYDISK.DAT label (12h bytes) equals DS:0A78, prompting 'Insert your PLAY DISK'; copies label to DS:190C

name: playdisk_load
notes: reads PLAYDISK.DAT into DS:0A78/09E0/0A34/0AFE/0B06/09C2, then car_lst_load(DS:0AFE) and scene_lst_load(DS:0B02); 0 = ok

name: car_lst_load
type: far int(int slot char *path char *name_dst u16 *pics_dst)
notes: slot must start with 'C' in DS:09E0; reads <car>.LST: name 13h -> name_dst, 13 u16 -> pics_dst (DS:0B50), 42h -> DS:E564, 7 -> DS:E541, 5 u16 -> DS:E77E, 10 -> DS:CEAE, 20 u16 -> DS:CC64, D9h -> DS:94B8, 35 u16 -> DS:1200, D2h -> DS:074C; 0 = ok

name: scene_lst_load
notes: slot must start with 'S' in DS:0A34; reads <scene>.LST: name 13h, 1 -> DS:0B0B, 29 u16 -> DS:0B16, 10 -> DS:0B0C, 1B0h -> DS:E5C0, 2C8h -> DS:8E04, 196h -> DS:081E; then clears and loads <scene>.HI (checksum) into DS:1FBB

name: hi_write
notes: recomputes DS:217C = XOR(DS:1FBB..217B) ^ 5Bh and writes 1C2h bytes to <scene>.HI (wb+); short write -> fatal 0000:0874(3) 'High score file update failed'

name: playdisk_screen
notes: 'PLAY DISK' screen: label, every loadable car name and course name

name: car_select
notes: car selection loop (DS:0AFE), spec card pages FL1/FL2

name: car_next
notes: next loadable car slot, wraps at DS:0B06

name: scene_select
notes: course selection loop (DS:0B02); writes PLAYDISK.DAT on change

name: scene_next
notes: next loadable scene slot, wraps at DS:0B07

name: scene_select_draw
notes: banner .ICN (pairs DS:0B16), first leg pictures (DS:0B1A/0B1C/0B1E), last leg pictures (DS:0B0B*6+0B14..)

name: options_screen
notes: skill level DS:0B04 (0-8, <3 auto-shift) and race against DS:0B08/0B09; writes PLAYDISK.DAT on change

name: leg_results
notes: end-of-leg screen: merges DS:09C6 into .HI route record and DS:09D0 into cumulative record (51e2), writes .HI when improved, prints leg/route names from DS:E5C0

name: draw_leg_record
type: far void(int x int y u8 *rec u8 flags)
notes: prints m:ss.hh, average speed (x8/5 for metric cars, DS:94B8=0) and 32-bit score of an 8-byte record

name: leg_record_merge
notes: keeps best time (1), best average speed (2), best score (4); returns the improved bits

name: shared_scene_load
notes: once: SCENETTT/SCENETTO/SCENETTP.BIN SCENETTA.DAT SCENETT1.DAT + menu pictures

name: race_run
notes: race runner: loads the stage, per-frame loop, returns when DS:008A = 3

name: stage_load_objects
notes: loads <scene>T.BIN -> DS:E770, O.BIN -> DS:E54C and P.BIN -> DS:CE9E when DS:0B15 = 0, car .POB -> DS:CEA4, opponents' .POB -> DS:CEBC / DS:D7A4 | loads leg sprite .DAT (DS:2500) T.BIN O.BIN P.BIN car POBs; calls 0792:0fce 0e12:2789 0e12:255e

name: leg_map_load
notes: loads <scene><'A'+leg>.DAT to DS:9592; EGA dither table B4B9; 95C7=0 darkening

name: steer_marker_draw
notes: marker at angle DS:E782*(2*DS:E33A-32), radius DS:E780, centre DS:E784/E786, colour DS:E77E

name: tach_draw
notes: needle DS:CC64 length, angle DS:CC66*(rpm>>5) - DS:CC8A*500h, centre DS:CC68/CC6A, colour DS:CEB4

name: odometer_draw
notes: at DS:CC78/CC7A; colours DS:CEB2/CEB3; rolling last digit DS:CEA8 (0-59)

name: speedo_draw
notes: needle DS:CC6C length, angle DS:CC6E*(speed>>2) - DS:CC88*500h, centre DS:CC70/CC72, colour DS:CEB5

name: odometer_update
notes: accumulates |velocity| into DS:1186; each DS:94B9 units -> DS:CEA8+1, 60 -> DS:E55E+1 (max 99)

name: load_opponent_pob_nonvga
notes: non-VGA only: reload opponent .POB into DS:CEBC

name: timer_install
notes: PIT ch0 divisor 2000h (145.6 Hz), hooks INT 8

name: timer_isr
notes: INT 8 at 145.65 Hz: snd_tick, DS:00A0++, chain to the old INT 8 every 8th tick

name: sfx_play_ax
notes: AX = effect id (0 = stop all, |80h = stop id): checks sound on/replay/effects off, priority DS:915E, script DS:918E

name: key_dispatch
notes: dispatch key code DS:E08C: 40h..7Fh via CS:0000 table, 81h..8Ah via DS:B6EF

name: gear_up
notes: DS:B6D7 += 1 up to DS:E564; sets throttle DS:B6D6 from DS:1232

name: gear_up_gate
notes: up-shift across lever ranges when DS:E5A5 > 1 (CERV)

name: gear_down_gate
notes: down-shift across lever ranges when DS:E5A5 > 1

name: grip_yaw_limit
notes: grip * DS:1200 / 4 * DS:E7E8 / 250 * DS:1238 / speed DS:1296 / 2 (7FFFh when speed is too low)

name: engine_sound
notes: per frame: start effect 1, pitch from DS:129C -> voice_noteword directly (see sound.md)

name: build_colour_remap
notes: fill DS:E5B0[32] colour-code remap (day/night DS:95C7, weather DS:BC75/BC77) | DS:E5B0[32] from 95C7 / BC75 / BC77

name: sprite_pixels_remap
notes: bytes >=10h via remap table (skipped in mode 13h)

name: sprites_prescale
notes: remap sprite pixels (non-VGA) and build scaled copies in far DS:E53C; message 1Ah on overflow

name: sprite_scale_setup
notes: reads sprite record (w h rowptr rowlen)

name: draw_sprite_child
notes: scaled sprite for a tile child (DS:9A73 entry)

name: draw_faces_and_sprites
notes: draw sorted face records (DS:BAB1 = colour pair, DS:BA9A = face type) and sprite children

name: faces_sort_keys
notes: per face record: depth = average (or max if w0 bit 13) of vertex depths DS:6382

name: draw_face_dispatch
notes: w0 bits 14-15: point 3bba / line 3c0c / triangle 3a91 / quad 3b0e | surface type (w3>>11) -> DS:BA9B at 3d28

name: fill_spans
notes: span filler into the RAM page (ES = DS:90D0); colour word byte-swapped on alternate rows (dither); OR mode when DS:BA9A == row>>7

name: obj_face_runtime_colours
notes: face types 20h-60h: lamp/brake/siren/traffic-light colours; 68h: animate vertices 0,1 from 12-byte frames (wipers)

name: obj_emit_vehicle_moving
notes: like 539d for moving objects; reuses cached vertices shifted by DS:BCC4/BCC6/BCC8 when unchanged

name: obj_emit_vehicle
notes: BX = object slot; 8-byte header, far LOD (bytes 4-7) when DX > 200h; caches transformed vertex/face ranges

name: traffic_follow_path
notes: advance a traffic object along its P-set waypoints (8 bytes: flags, h, x, z) | P.BIN waypoints per cell; branches; cell change at lane exits

name: path_tile_lookup
notes: SI = map cell: heading -> DS:946A, lane-path list of the tile type in P set (DS:CE9E) -> DS:BCB8 / DS:946D | SI=cell index -> P.BIN list; 946A rotation; 946D count

name: vehicle_collisions
notes: pairwise test of moving objects with the collision boxes of their models

name: vehicle_collision_boxes
notes: test one object's collision boxes (8 bytes: A,B,C,r,h) against DS:BCC4/BCC6/BCC8; sets DS:946C bits

name: crossing_gate_update
notes: object model 10h vs train models 12h-14h; speed 95D6

name: draw_point
notes: point size DS:95D9[w0 bits 11-12] scaled by depth; w0 bit 13 = one-sided

name: world_cells_collect
notes: per-tile loop over the map (DS:9671): road tile via 72f8, then placed static objects of that tile via 72f8 | car cell -> visible cells (CS:7068/7004 tables) -> 72f8 per cell and per static object; sets route index DS:0A74

name: obj_emit_static
notes: AL = object index, AH != 0 -> O table (DS:E54C), else T tables (DS:E7E0 < 40h, DS:E770 >= 40h); 4-byte header; transforms (75c1), emits faces (7487) and sprite children into DS:9A73/9CF3/9F73/A1F3 | AL=type AH=0 tile (E7E0 <40h / E770) AH=1 O.BIN; vertices faces and sprite children

name: obj_emit_faces
notes: copy CX-DS:BD24 faces to 10-byte records at DS:E5B8 (4 words + vertex base DS:945E, colour codes -> pixel pair via DS:E5B0, DS:B4B9, DS:B6B9) | face list + colour pair (B4B9/B6B9)

name: obj_transform_verts
notes: transform DS:946B vertices at SI (A/B/C arrays) into DS:2502 (height), DS:3182, DS:3E02; sets DS:BD22 on vertex-buffer overflow (630h) | Y X Z arrays + BD2E / BD30 / BD32

name: vert_rotate
notes: read A=[si], B=[si+bx], C=[si+2bx]; rotate B/C by heading DS:946A (sin/cos DS:B851/B7CF), shear A by DS:BD38; returns DX:AX | quarter turns + sin/cos by 946A

name: frame_update
notes: per-frame world/car update (calls 0977:0008, 0ab4:1220) and first draw pass

name: gfx_set_mode
notes: mode 00..14h, <0 = current BIOS mode; stores mode*2 in DS:BD44 (dispatch index) and mode in DS:BD49. 13h = BIOS mode 13h, 14h = unchained 320x200x256 (game VGA mode), 0Dh/0Eh EGA, 08h-0Ah Tandy, 0Bh/0Ch Hercules

name: music_notes_off
notes: all voices owned by music: forced note off, owner/priority 0; clears music-playing bit (C5E1 bit 0)

name: music_play
notes: (far ptr song, fade, vol): pos = ptr+2, master_vol, countdown 1, reclaim voices; game always passes 0,0

name: music_stop
notes: (mode): 0 = stop now; bit 7 = stop at next loop/Bx event; else fade-out speed (unused)

name: voice_release
notes: (voice): stop an effect on a voice: key off, owner/priority/note 0, free its sfx slot

name: music_claim_voices
notes: every voice not held by an effect with priority > 40h -> owner 1 (music), priority 40h

name: music_restart
notes: restart the loaded song if ready and stopped; no callers

name: music_pause
notes: notes off and clear C5E0 bit 0; no callers

name: music_init
notes: (device 0/1/2/4/8xh): probe hardware, load INSTR.DAT bank, select routines, else PC speaker

name: snd_reset_tables
notes: zero DS:C638..C799, copy default velocity/channel tables C79A -> C6B8 (A0h bytes)

name: snd_select_routines
notes: BX = device index 0-4: C5E3 = C901[bx]; copy routine pointers C92E.. -> C906..C90E and freq tables C91A/C924 -> C916/C918; AdLib: silent snare strike

name: instr_load
notes: SI = section: open INSTR.DAT, skip SI sections, skip name, read 162h bytes to DS:C638, DOS-alloc count*size and read the instruments (far C96A)

name: music_reset
notes: device all-off, clear C83D..C852; no callers

name: snd_tick
notes: timer tick (145.65 Hz, from 0c1c:10e8): clear voice_busy, sfx_modulate, sfx_step, music fade, run due music events

name: music_fade
notes: per tick fade of master_vol C5DE (fade-in branch unreachable: bug); unused by the game

name: mus_ev_note_off
notes: event 8x: device note off if voice <= 13

name: mus_ev_note_on
notes: event 9x: vel 0 = off; vel = clamp(vel + C6B8[program]) + master_vol, 1..127; device note on, priority 40h

name: mus_ev_loop
notes: event Ax: count 0 = loop start; else loop end with total pass count; per-voice state C853/C859/C85F/C865

name: mus_ev_stop_point
notes: event Bx: stop if music_ctl bit 7

name: mus_ev_program
notes: event Cx: voice_program = prog; device program change

name: mus_ev_loop_exit
notes: event Dx: jump to loop_exit of the voice

name: mus_ev_end
notes: event Fx: FC = stop song (halt, music_notes_off)

name: voice_alloc_check
notes: carry = reject: effect-owned voice with higher priority, or (non MPU) a same-tick note that is not higher; claims the voice for music

name: mpu_note_on
notes: MPU: D0h, 9x+voice, note (rhythm voice: C758[note-36]), velocity

name: mpu_set_freq
notes: MPU: pitch bend from note word fraction

name: mpu_note_off
notes: MPU: forced = controller 7Bh (all notes off), else 8x note 0

name: mpu_command
notes: AH = command to port 331h, wait for ACK FEh

name: adlib_set_tl
notes: SI = voice slot index: TL = 63 - vel/2 for carriers (and modulators of slots > 6 or CA15[slot]), else instrument TL CA05[slot]

name: adlib_note_on
notes: BL voice, CH note, DL vel, CL fraction, DH priority: voice 9 = rhythm (CA30/C758/BD), else note-19, alloc check, key off, TL, key on

name: note_fold
notes: fold CH into AL..AH by octaves, store voice_noteword

name: adlib_set_freq
notes: voices 0-8: A0h+v = fnum low, B0h+v = fnum high | block<<2 | key-on shadow

name: adlib_note_off
notes: voice 9: clear BD bit; voices 0-8: clear key-on if forced or the note matches

name: adlib_load_instrument
notes: CH = instrument: 9 bytes -> 20/40/60/80 of both slots, byte 8 -> register C0h (sic, not C0h+voice)

name: adlib_program
notes: voices 0-5: load instrument C638[prog]; voices 6+: voice_program = CA25[voice]

name: adlib_load_bank
notes: instr_load(0), then instrument CA25[v] into voices 10..0

name: spk_note_on
notes: PC speaker: note-24, one voice, port 61h |= 3

name: spk_set_freq
notes: PC speaker: PIT ch 2 divisor = CAAA[semi] >> octave

name: spk_note_off
notes: PC speaker off if the note matches

name: voice_modulate
notes: AL voice, SI slot*2: noteword += slide + step; device set_freq if changed

name: sfx_modulate
notes: per tick: vibrato counters, modulate effect slots 2..1 and music voices (slot 0 values)

name: freq_lookup
notes: CH note, CL fraction -> AX = freq_table[n%12] + (CL>>4)*freq_step[n%12], CL = octave

name: sfx_start
notes: (near script ptr, priority) -> voice or FFFFh: take voice 5 (slot 2) or 4 (slot 1), lower priority first

name: sfx_step
notes: per tick: one script opcode per active slot (CB3C table) unless waiting

name: sfx_op_vibrato
notes: op 3 (period, step): triangle LFO on the note word

name: sfx_op_note
notes: op 6 (note, vel): key off, note on with the effect priority

name: sfx_op_reset
notes: op 10: clear slot modulation/loop state, wait 1

name: sfx_op_program
notes: op 11 (p): device program with C638[p] (mapped through C638 twice on AdLib)

name: sfx_op_goto_engine
notes: op 12 (addr): become effect id 1 (engine) unless engine off (C900) or already playing, else end

name: sfx_init
notes: (device): like music_init for the effect side, sets C5E0 bit 2

name: sfx_stop_all
notes: voice_release for the voices of slots 2..0

name: adlib_write
notes: AL = register, AH = value: 388h/389h with 6 and 35 status-read delays

name: adlib_detect_reset
notes: timer-based OPL detection; clears F5h..01h, 04h=60h, BDh=20h (rhythm mode), 01h=20h; AX = found

name: protection_ok
notes: 1 = copy protection passed (full game); 0 = back to menus after one run

name: snd_device_cfg
notes: TD3.CFG sound device 0-4 (3 -> 81h MT-32); after snd_init = C5E3 device id

name: timer_ticks
notes: 145.6 Hz tick counter (likely); race frame loop waits for >= 5 ticks

name: steering_response
notes: 1-9, default 4 (PLAYDISK.DAT last byte); steering rate factor 3*x+16

name: leg_result
notes: current player's leg record {min,sec,hund,avg mph,u32 score}

name: race_result
notes: cumulative record over the legs so far

name: route_index
notes: route 0-2 taken in the current leg | 0..2 current alternative route

name: cars_on_disk
notes: number of car slots to cycle (PLAYDISK)

name: scenes_on_disk
notes: number of scene slots to cycle (PLAYDISK)

name: race_players
notes: number of human players 1-4 taking turns per leg (1 shown as Clock)

name: scene_pic_pairs
notes: scene .LST 14h: .ICN pairs, .SIC pairs, 9 x {.ALZ pairs, .BLZ pairs, picture-set digit}

name: car_physics
notes: car .LST 18Bh: grip, engine drag, auto-shift points, gear ratios x100 (DS:1212 + 2*gear), steering, brakes, torque, rev limit, top speed (see descriptions.md)

name: gear_ratios
notes: x100, index = gear (0 R, 1 N, 2.. forward)

name: car_top_speed
notes: speed governor in speed units (~1.64 mph)

name: hi_car
notes: .HI 00h: car slot of each top-7 entry

name: hi_names
notes: .HI 23h: print string, 7 x {col 1Ah, row, name[15], 80h}, last 80h -> AAh

name: hi_route_best
notes: .HI A1h: best {min,sec,hund,avg mph,u32 score} per leg and route

name: hi_cumulative_best
notes: .HI 179h: best cumulative record through each leg

name: hi_checksum
notes: .HI 1C1h: XOR of the 1C1h bytes before it, ^ 5Bh

name: protection_sheet
notes: scene .LST 208h or MASTERQ.BIN: copy-protection code sheet

name: sfx_voice
notes: voice of each effect id, FFh = none

name: engine_script_note
notes: note byte of the engine script, patched by engine_sound

name: car_imperial
notes: car .LST B2h: 1 = miles/mph (DETAIL1.LZ), 0 = km (DETAIL2.LZ; results x5/8 -> mph)

name: car_odo_step
notes: distance units per 1/60 odometer unit (50000h mile, 31999h km)

name: car_cockpit_colour
notes: colour pair of the cockpit polygon drawn in the 3D view (0e12:4bf3)

name: leg_map
notes: 32x16 cells: type | height<<8 | rot<<14; row 0 = north

name: surface_under_car
notes: w3>>11 of face under the car; 1Fh = leg finish

name: gfx_mode_x2
notes: current graphics mode * 2 (index into per-mode jump tables)

name: snd_ready
notes: bit 0 music ready, bit 2 effects ready

name: snd_active
notes: bit 0 music playing, bit 2 effect active

name: music_ctl
notes: bit 4 loaded, 5 fade in, 6 fade out, 7 stop at loop point, bits 0-3 fade speed

name: snd_default_tables
notes: defaults copied to C6B8 by snd_reset_tables

name: music_wait
notes: tick countdown to the next events

name: music_status
notes: status byte of the current event

name: adlib_voice_slots
notes: voice -> modulator/carrier slot, FFh single operator

name: adlib_inst_conn
notes: instrument C0 bit 0 per voice (read per slot: quirk)

name: sfx_ops
notes: opcode handlers 0-12 via [CB3C+2*op]; entry 0 overlaps sfx_slot_voice[1..2]

name: car_gauges
notes: car .LST 8Ah: tach and speedo needles, odometer position, backing rectangles

name: car_tach_max
notes: tach needle clamp in rpm>>5 steps

name: car_colours
notes: car .LST 80h: radar bars, odometer, needles, top-bar digits

name: car_unused_e541
notes: car .LST 6Fh: 0F 07 08 00 0C 04 04 in every car; no reader (the lever colours are hard-coded)

name: scene_leg_names
notes: scene .LST 58h: per leg name[12] + 3 route names[12]

name: car_steer_marker
notes: car .LST 76h: colour, radius, angle step, centre x, centre y

name: music_buf
notes: THEME.MUS / NEWWAVE.MUS (6000 bytes inside the DS:E770 block)
